descriptionByLocale.it: Do you always put clients at the center of everything you do? Are you passionate about creating a welcoming and positive atmosphere? As additional support for our team in Geneva, we are looking for a new colleague (female or male) to join us as an Event Attendant on an hourly, on-call basis (on average, approximately 65 hours per year). In this role, you will be responsible for welcoming guests and providing excellent client service at a variety of events, including client gatherings, press conferences, and third-party events involving UBS. You will support the event manager and play a key role in ensuring each event runs smoothly and safely.
